animations.name: Aquarium
animations.description: A living reef: the fish school rests at night, flees a roaming predator, and swarms feeding events, under a day/night lighting cycle with sunbeams, plankton, kelp, and sand crabs.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Attractor
animations.description: A particle tracing a real strange-attractor equation — Lorenz butterfly and Rössler ribbon rendered as speed-weighted ASCII glyphs through a slowly rotating 3D camera.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Aurora
animations.description: Procedural aurora borealis ribbons with twinkling star field.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Black Hole
animations.description: Accretion disk animation with jet toggle, disk size, and inclination.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Boids Flock
animations.description: Classic boid flocking — separation, alignment, cohesion — with an optional predator that scatters the flock.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Bonsai
animations.description: Procedural tree growth with leaf density and rest time between redraws.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Campfire
animations.description: Layered noise-driven flame tongues with rising embers, a dark forest silhouette, and a drifting firefly.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Crawl
animations.description: Retro title crawl with selectable episode and text speed.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Crystals
animations.description: Geological cave growth simulation with procedural stalactites, stalagmites, and a glowing bioluminescent pool.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Cyber Deck
animations.description: A fictional 1998 hacker terminal that never finishes booting — boot sequence, hex dumps, hardware diagrams, glitches and the occasional kernel panic.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: DNA Helix
animations.description: 3D rotating DNA double helix structure.
animations.author: Luci Evol

params.label: Zoom Level
params.description: How close the camera sits to the helix.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used to draw the base pairs.

animations.name: Fireworks
animations.description: Exploding fireworks into ASCII particles.
animations.author: Luci Evol

params.label: Frequency
params.description: How often a new firework launches.

params.label: Particle Count
params.description: How many particles each explosion scatters.

params.label: Gravity
params.description: How quickly falling particles accelerate downward.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the explosions.

animations.name: Fluid
animations.description: Real-time fluid dynamics simulation with dye injection rendered in ASCII.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Spiral Galaxy
animations.description: Rotating ASCII spiral galaxy.
animations.author: Luci Evol

params.label: Arm Count
params.description: How many spiral arms the galaxy has.

params.label: Star Density
params.description: How many stars are drawn along each arm.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the stars and core.

animations.name: Game of Life
animations.description: Conway cells rendered as growing and wilting garden glyphs.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Glitch Field
animations.description: A broken digital reality — a character grid torn by drifting corruption bands, RGB split, scanline tearing and packet loss.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Incense
animations.description: Smoke particle simulation rising from an incense stick with wind and turbulence controls.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Jellyfish Drift
animations.description: Bioluminescent jellyfish drifting through deep-sea darkness with pulsing bell glow, wavy trailing tentacles, and plankton sparkle.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Mandelbrot
animations.description: Zooming ASCII fractal with auto-jumping boundary regions.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Matrix
animations.description: Digital rain effect in ASCII.
animations.author: Luci Evol

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the falling characters.

params.label: Density
params.description: How many character columns are active at once.

animations.name: Moon
animations.description: Orbital ASCII scene with star count, floaters, glow, and palette.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Nixie
animations.description: Vintage nixie tube clock with cathode poisoning, neon glow bloom, and per-tube flicker. Inspired by joeparadiso/nixie-tube-clock.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Ocean Waves
animations.description: Rolling ASCII ocean waves.
animations.author: Luci Evol

params.label: Wave Speed
params.description: How fast the waves roll across the screen.

params.label: Turbulence
params.description: How choppy and irregular the water looks.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the water.

animations.name: Oscilloscope
animations.description: A CRT lab instrument left running forever — a glowing phosphor Lissajous trace with decay, scanlines and bloom.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Pendulum Wave
animations.description: Pendulums of progressively shorter period swinging in and out of phase — travelling waves that periodically snap back into perfect sync.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Pipes
animations.description: Growing pipe network using Unicode box-drawing characters.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Planet
animations.description: Rotating planet sphere with atmosphere, optional rings, and polar aurora.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Sand Mandala
animations.description: Radial sand mandala that builds grain by grain, holds, dissolves, and rebuilds.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Spider Web
animations.description: A spider builds its web strand by strand, hunts drifting prey, flees wasp raids and bird strikes, and repairs the damage — all under a soft moonlight glow.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Terrarium
animations.description: A living ecosystem: plants grow, seed, wilt and decay; fungi recycle litter into soil nutrients; detritivores, leaf-grazing snails, a centipede predator, and a foraging ant colony cycle through closed water, nutrient, and light cycles under day/night and seasons. Nothing goes extinct.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Thunderstorm
animations.description: Dynamic rain, lightning bolts, and storm clouds in ASCII.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Vinyl Spin
animations.description: Spinning turntable with a rotating groove sheen, procedural radial label, tracking tonearm, and lamplit dust motes.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Volcanic Flow
animations.description: Night mountain with a glowing crater, lava flowing down a fixed channel, eruption sparks, and a rising smoke plume.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Waterfall
animations.description: Cascading waterfall through a mossy rock channel with a base mist/spray burst and an optional faint rainbow arc.
animations.author: Luci Evol

animations.name: Wind Chimes
animations.description: Hanging chime tubes swaying as damped pendulums in a gusty breeze, with proximity glint flashes and synthesized bell tones (press M to toggle sound).
animations.author: Luci Evol
